zh_CN: 宁华的大型平台把各地的日常消息拢到一处。工作日从通勤群聊里冒头的话题，常在午休时就传到了别的城市。
en: Large platforms gather everyday news from across Ninghua. A conversation in a commuter chat can reach another city by lunchtime.

zh_CN:
“无穷的远方，无数的人们，都和我有关。”
鲁迅《“这也是生活”……》
en:
“The boundless distance and countless people are all connected with me.”
Lu Xun, “This Too Is Life”...

zh_CN: 熟悉的口头禅常被套进新场景。外地笑话通常要先讲清来龙去脉，才好接进本地闲聊。
en: People here fit familiar catchphrases into new situations. Imported jokes travel more easily once someone explains the backstory so others can work them into local conversation.

zh_CN: 工作、教育、住房、生活成本
审核、自发性解构、品牌节庆
压力口头禅、消费笑话、粉圈图像
en: Stress catchphrases; consumer jokes; fandom images

zh_CN: 汐原的创作社群围着具体作品聚散。新作一发布，学生论坛很快就贴出截图；老作品也一直有人整理、讨论。
en: Creative communities in Shiohara gather around specific works. Student forums soon share screenshots of new releases, while people keep cataloguing details and discussing older titles.

zh_CN:
“不畏雨，也不畏风。”
宫泽贤治《不畏风雨》
en:
“Not losing to the rain, not losing to the wind.”
Kenji Miyazawa, Ame ni mo Makezu

zh_CN: 一句台词或一张反应图，背后往往连着整段原作剧情。改编者会留住眼熟的细节，方便同好认出出处。
en: A line or reaction image can carry a whole scene behind it. When people adapt a work, they leave recognizable details in place so fellow fans can trace the source.

zh_CN: 文娱、档案、身份认同、社区
新作上线、连载休止、社群争论
en: New releases; publication hiatus; community disputes

zh_CN: 角色反应图、旧作引用、日常四格
en: Character reactions; older works; everyday comic panels

zh_CN: 瑞原的文化社群联系紧密。有人攒素材，有人接力翻译，一场约好的线上活动就能让许多小群同时热闹起来。
en: Cultural communities in Seowon stay closely connected. Members gather material and translate it for one another; a planned online event can bring many small groups together.

zh_CN:
“愿直到死去那天，仰望天空也没有一点羞愧。”
尹东柱《序诗》
en:
“Until the day I die, may I look up at the sky without a speck of shame.”
Yun Dong-ju, Foreword

zh_CN: 应援和二创都讲究配合。圈内暗语让同好迅速认出彼此，传到圈外时常要补充背景。
en: Fan projects and remixes rely on coordination. Shared shorthand helps fans recognize one another, though it often needs explaining once it travels outside the group.

zh_CN: 文娱、身份认同、技术工具、语言
应援接力、同步活动、解释分裂
en: Fan relays; coordinated events; divided interpretations

zh_CN: 应援口号、反应图、圈内暗语
en: Fan slogans; reaction images; insider language

zh_CN: 阿尔登的商业平台每天涌入大量新内容。热榜换得快，上班途中看到的笑话，晚上可能已换了一套说法。
en: Alden's commercial platforms take in a steady stream of new posts. Trends turn over quickly: a joke seen on the way to work may take on a different meaning by evening.

zh_CN:
“我也歌唱美利坚。”
兰斯顿·休斯《我也》
en:
“I, too, sing America.”
Langston Hughes, I, Too

zh_CN: 通用模板很容易被不同圈子拿去用。品牌方和普通用户都在争取关注，同一张图常被用来表达相反的态度。
en: Reusable templates move easily between communities. Brands and individuals compete for attention, often using the same image to express opposing views.

zh_CN: 技术工具、科学、工作、公共议题
en: Technical tools; Science; Work; Public issues

zh_CN: 热榜助推、品牌借用、争议循环
en: Trending boosts; brand appropriation; controversy cycles

zh_CN: 通用模板、愤怒诱饵、名人反应图
en: Generic templates; outrage bait; celebrity reactions

zh_CN: 在韦列斯克的学生论坛上，旧图常被拿来配眼下的烦心事。房租、身份和平台变化，都能变成下一轮改图的题材。
en: On Veresk's student forums, old images keep returning with current frustrations attached. Rent and questions of identity sit alongside complaints about changing platforms.

zh_CN:
“你们笑什么？你们笑的是自己！”
尼古拉·果戈理《钦差大臣》第五幕
en:
“What are you laughing at? You are laughing at yourself, oh you!”
Nikolai Gogol, The Government Inspector, Act V

zh_CN: 荒诞对白和一本正经的反话在这里很常见。听懂这些笑话，常要先知道大家最近在烦什么。
en: Absurd dialogue and deadpan irony are common here. Understanding a joke often starts with knowing what people have been complaining about lately.

zh_CN: 住房、生活成本、档案、身份认同
旧梗复兴、反讽直译、集体改名
en: Old meme revival; literalized irony; collective renaming

zh_CN: 旧图新字、荒诞台词、本地双关
en: Recaptioned images; absurd dialogue; local puns

zh_CN: 林达尔的公共网络规模较小，居民联系方便。外地消息传得快，学校和公共服务的话题常围绕具体社区展开。
en: Lindal has a compact, well-connected public network. Outside news arrives quickly, while discussions about schools or public services often stay close to specific communities.

zh_CN:
“世界上最强大的人，是最孤立无援的人。”
亨利克·易卜生《人民公敌》第五幕
en:
“the strongest man in the world is he who stands most alone.”
Henrik Ibsen, An Enemy of the People, Act V

zh_CN: 本地人习惯给外地读者补上背景，也爱拿熟悉的日常开玩笑。机构借用网络表达时，同样会被居民拿来评说。
en: Locals fill in background context for outsiders and joke about familiar routines. Institutions that borrow online expressions become part of the conversation too.

zh_CN: 医疗健康、家庭照护、教育、气候环境
地方议题、语境解释、机构借用
en: Local issues; contextual explanation; institutional appropriation

zh_CN: 日常自嘲、公共服务图、双语笑话
en: Everyday self-irony; public-service images; bilingual jokes

zh_CN: 马拉苏的城市和跨境社群来往频繁。通勤路上，人们聊比赛，也交换省钱门道；不同地区的网络接入条件仍有差别。
en: Marasu's cities have frequent contact with cross-border communities. Commuters talk matches and swap money-saving tips on the move; network access still varies from place to place.

zh_CN:
“我要再活一千年。”
海里尔·安瓦尔《我》
en:
“I want to live another thousand years.”
Chairil Anwar, Aku

zh_CN: 同一段话里可以夹着不同语言。双关语和家庭反应图传得快，翻译接力也会带出新的意思。
en: Several languages can share the same conversation. Puns and family reaction images travel quickly, picking up new meanings as people translate them.

zh_CN: 交通出行、语言、旅游、贸易
语码混用、翻译漂移、节庆热点
多语双关、家庭反应图、城市段子
en: Multilingual puns; family reactions; city jokes

zh_CN: 南美参考圈 · 聊天转发网络
塞拉诺瓦的消息常沿群聊传开。学生分享课堂和街坊间的见闻，熟人接着转发，也追问出处。
en: News in Serranova often moves through group chats. Students share classroom and neighbourhood stories, and friends pass them on while asking where they came from.

zh_CN:
“图书馆是无限而周期性的。”
豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯《巴别图书馆》
en:
“The Library is unlimited and periodic.”
Jorge Luis Borges, The Library of Babel

zh_CN: 比赛画面和连续剧表情常被截成聊天贴图。换个场合，同一张图就能从助兴变成抱怨。
en: Match clips and television reactions regularly get cropped into chat stickers. Put the same sticker into a different chat, and an image used to celebrate can just as easily serve as a complaint.

zh_CN: 体育、文娱、社区、饮食与粮食
群聊接力、贴图截取、赛事热点
en: Group-chat relays; sticker extraction; sporting trends

zh_CN: 体育口号、连续剧反应图、聊天贴图
en: Sports slogans; television reactions; chat stickers

zh_CN: 撒哈拉以南非洲 · 多语创作网络
奥鲁维亚的城市创作者常从街头日常取材。交通、物价和工作中的小事写成短对白，传到别处再按当地情况改编。
en: Urban creators in Oruvia draw material from street life. Everyday stories about transport and prices become short dialogues that people elsewhere adapt to their own working lives.

zh_CN:
“谚语是让话语下咽的棕榈油。”
钦努阿·阿契贝《瓦解》第一章
en:
“proverbs are the palm-oil with which words are eaten.”
Chinua Achebe, Things Fall Apart, chapter 1

zh_CN: 本地口语让影视截帧和短对白更亲切。跨地区转发时，创作者会把人物台词改成自己熟悉的说法。
en: Local speech makes film stills and short dialogues feel familiar. As material moves between regions, creators adapt the voices to their own surroundings.

zh_CN: 工作、交通出行、饮食与粮食、技术工具
接入改善、本地对白、跨区域改写
en: Improved access; local dialogue; cross-regional rewriting

zh_CN: 城市日常对白、影视截帧、物价段子
en: Urban dialogue; film stills; price jokes

zh_CN: 往返于纳希尔城和萨法港的人，常把一路上的见闻带进邻里群。社区日常和公共安排，是大家下班后还会接着聊的话题。
en: People traveling between Nashir City and Safa Port bring news from along the way into neighborhood chats. Community life and public arrangements remain topics of conversation after work.

zh_CN:
“我是两种文明的儿子。”
纳吉布·马哈福兹，诺贝尔文学奖获奖演说（1988）
en:
“I am the son of two civilizations”
Naguib Mahfouz, Nobel Lecture (1988)

zh_CN: 消息常带着具体的人和地点。居民习惯先问清是谁说的，再用简短对白把身边的事讲出来。
en: Messages here often come with a specific person and place attached. Residents ask who said it, then retell what happened in short exchanges.

zh_CN: 饮食与粮食、能源、贸易、社区
索莱里亚的学生社群常把课余演出和比赛一路聊到深夜，打工的抱怨也会混进同一串热闹讨论。
en: Student communities in Soleria talk through performances and matches late into the night, folding complaints about part-time jobs into the very same threads.

zh_CN:
“我的祖国是葡萄牙语。”
费尔南多·佩索阿《不安之书》
en:
“My homeland is the Portuguese language.”
Fernando Pessoa, The Book of Disquiet

zh_CN: 影视台词会被改成日常问答，赛场上的动作也能拿来当表情。熟悉的场面，让一群人很快就能接上话。
en: People turn film lines into everyday conversation and use match gestures as reactions. Familiar scenes give a group an easy way to join in.

zh_CN: 旅游、饮食与粮食、体育、文娱
阿文顿的文化社群散布在城镇与港口。新说法传到别处，常有人问：“这话在你们那儿是什么意思？”
en: Avendon's cultural communities are spread across towns and ports. Whenever a new phrase travels from one place to another, the next question is often, 'What does that mean where you live?'

zh_CN:
“真相很少纯粹，也从不简单。”
奥斯卡·王尔德《不可儿戏》第一幕
en:
“The truth is rarely pure and never simple.”
Oscar Wilde, The Importance of Being Earnest, Act I

zh_CN: 双语转述和地方自嘲在这里很常见。聊起公共议题，人们会翻出旧报道，也会为一句话的语气争论很久。
en: Bilingual retellings and jokes about local life are common. When public issues come up, people draw on old reports and can spend a long time discussing the tone of a single sentence.

zh_CN: 公共议题、信任、语言、迁移与侨居
莱茵维亚的通勤群聊里，常有人翻出旧海报或老节目片段。过去的东西能拿来评论眼下的工作，也能顺势聊起原作。
en: Commuter chats in Rhenivia regularly surface old posters and program clips. People use those fragments to comment on today's work or drift into a conversation about the original piece.

zh_CN:
“先得填饱肚子，才轮得到道德。”
贝托尔特·布莱希特《三分钱歌剧》第二幕终曲
en:
“First comes food, then morality.”
Bertolt Brecht, The Threepenny Opera, second-act finale

zh_CN: 整理出处和给老图重新配字，在这儿各有各的同好。同一个旧片段可以反复用，每次留下不同的注解。
en: Some people love tracing sources while others prefer writing fresh captions. The same old clip can return again and again with a different commentary each time.

zh_CN: 米赫兰的学生论坛常交流生活开销和上网工具的使用门道。达里亚港传来的新说法，也在讨论中被解释、试用，改成当地人熟悉的表达。
en: Student forums in Mehran trade practical tips on living expenses and network tools. New expressions arriving through Darya Port get unpacked, tested, and rewritten inside those same threads.

zh_CN:
“劳动是看得见的爱。”
纪伯伦《先知·论工作》
en:
“Work is love made visible.”
Kahlil Gibran, The Prophet, On Work

zh_CN: 管用的省钱窍门常被编成便于转发的短句。不同社群借用时，会换上自家的称呼和日常细节。
en: Useful money-saving tips get pared down into short, shareable lines. As different circles pass the same sentence around, each one swaps in its own forms of address and everyday details.

zh_CN: 生活成本、贸易、技术工具、语言
en: Living costs; Trade; Technical tools; Language

zh_CN: 坎塔利亚各地的文化小组在网上交换讲座、演出消息和旧照片。学校与工作的经历，又给这些材料添上新话题。
en: Cultural groups across Cantalia exchange talks and performance notices online. Old photographs circulate too, bringing stories of school and work into the conversation.

zh_CN:
“完美的午后慢慢成熟，慢慢褪色，慢慢收拢了花瓣。”
凯瑟琳·曼斯菲尔德《花园茶会》
en:
“And the perfect afternoon slowly ripened, slowly faded, slowly its petals closed.”
Katherine Mansfield, The Garden Party

zh_CN: 本地故事常和外地流行表达放在一起。有人补记出处，有人改成自己的经历，留下各不相同的版本。
en: Local stories sit alongside expressions arriving from elsewhere. Some people add source notes; others recast the stories around their own lives.

zh_CN: 家庭照护、气候环境、教育、医疗健康
维沙拉的通勤职员习惯在路上互通生活消息。物价和平台工具的变化，很快就会变成办公室里能听懂的笑话。
en: Commuters in Vishara trade everyday news on the way to work. Shifts in prices or online tools quickly turn into jokes that people around the office recognize.

zh_CN:
“在那里，心灵无所畏惧，头颅高高昂起。”
拉宾德拉纳特·泰戈尔《吉檀迦利》第35首
en:
“Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high;”
Rabindranath Tagore, Gitanjali, poem 35

zh_CN: 各社群会用熟悉的称呼和暗语标记彼此的关系。一段表达传进新圈子后，字句常被改得更贴近当地人的日常。
en: Communities use familiar names and shorthand to mark their relationships. When an expression enters a new circle, its wording often gets adjusted to fit local routines.
